correctness.rationale: The Weierstrass coefficients depend only on w=v^4. Published Proposition 5.6 gives generic rank twelve and Appendix A.10 gives a nonsingular 12-section specialization at v=5. Therefore specializing the full twelve-dimensional rational span is injective. Exact mixed height computations with the transformed sections at v=5i recover the genuine generic action matrix T=H^{-1}G; all 144 pairings use exact polynomial gcds and split IV corrections. The checker verifies all twelve Weierstrass identities over Q(i)[v,t], H det=4096/9, T integral with T^4=I, H-isometry, traces (12,4,4,4), and independently T^2 from v=-5. A second v=7 specialization reproduces T. Galois invariants and character arithmetic rigorously yield ranks 6,8,12. The proof depends on published premises, not on finite samples proving universal upper bounds.
